name: Main journal browse
list_contents: questType 1: active scenario quests + active guildleves + passive guildleves; other questTypes use completed quest list
selection_behavior: Opens QuestDetailWidget for specific scenario ranges; otherwise JournalDetailWidget.

name: Active guildleve select
ask_result: resultJournalID when finished by parent path

name: Passive guildleve/quest select
selection_behavior: If JournalType 2, sets guildleveFlag true; finish result used by askPassiveGuildleveSelectWidget.

name: Guildleve change bonus select
selection_behavior: Requires arg actor; calls argActor:selectGuildleveChangeBonus(JournalIndex), then finish(JournalID).

name: Cutscene replay quest selection
list_contents: completed cutscene replay quests from cutReplaySheet and _isCompletedCutSceneReplayQuest
selection_behavior: Open child ReplayCutsceneSelectWidget unless special 110820 family, then finish directly.
